sources.title: GitHub - EthanCsakany/Clinical-Note-Summarizer
sources.snippet: Motivation Clinical documentation is one of the largest time sinks for healthcare providers. This project explores whether LLMs can meaningfully compress clinical notes while preserving critical medical information — specifically medication accuracy, since a hallucinated or dropped medication in a clinical summary is a real patient-safety risk, not just an inconvenience.

sources.title: GitHub - imkalpx/medical-note-summarizer
sources.snippet: Fine-tunes Llama 2 7B (via Replicate managed LoRA training) to convert free-text clinical notes into structured summaries with fixed sections: DIAGNOSIS, KEY FINDINGS, MEDICATIONS, ACTION ITEMS, FOLLOW-UP. Includes synthetic dataset generation, a full evaluation framework (ROUGE, BLEU, structure compliance, hallucination checks), a Streamlit comparison app, and Hugging Face publishing.
